item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump dramatic overhaul of Head Start could gut preschool standards
item.description: President Trump's administration is planning a dramatic overhaul of Head Start that would gut its quality standards, upending the hallmarks of the early education program for impoverished children.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mets trade pitcher Freddy Peralta to Rays for 3 minor leaguers
item.description: The first-place Tampa Bay Rays gave their starting rotation a boost Sunday, acquiring pitcher Freddy Peralta from the struggling New York Mets for three minor leaguers.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Mauricio Pochettino stays as US coach, agrees to 4-year contract extension through 2030 World Cup
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino is staying with the U.S. soccer team, agreeing Monday to a four-year contract to coach the Americans through the 2030 World Cup.

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Lakeland deputy-involved shooting sends suspect to hospital: PCSO
item.description: A man was hospitalized Monday morning after an encounter with law enforcement in Lakeland, according to the Polk County Sheriff’s Office.
